text_block_list.text:
As Rose Kingdom was not feeling well,
I brought her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: I shall take a moment's rest, then.

――Ro... dom...
...come... over...

――Rose Kingdom.
Come here to me.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Is this... our estate...? No, yet... it seems strangely antique...
So you are the Rose Clan of this generation.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
――!
You... could you truly be of my clan...?

Rose Kingdom...
I have a request of you.
I want you to inherit my 'secret art.'
I shall bestow it upon you now.

One, two, three, four!
...Splendid work, Rose Kingdom.
You have striven valiantly. ...To you, who have so splendidly inherited my secret art—I have just one more request.
Glory and victory to my house... Please.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...!
I see... Is that how it is.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
I will carry on your will—and seize our glory without fail.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove?
text_block_list.text: Heh... Do not presume you can wrest the lead from me so easily.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
――!
Such exquisite footwork... not to mention that solid core and crisp, fluid motion...!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(So this is the barrier that once stood
before "us"...! However...!)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Hmph—!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove?
text_block_list.text:
...!!
What is this... these footwork steps...?!!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Victory will be ours.
And then, our clan shall――――!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove?
text_block_list.text:
...That was a splendid dance, Rose Kingdom.
May you continue to wage glorious battles
with those who inherit my will...—

Thank you, Rose Kingdom...
Please, carry our kingdom forward————

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Hah...!!
Just a dream, was it...?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(No, but that person is............
—I must seize victory. And in this very generation,
build our Rose Kingdom...————)

Having experienced a dream akin to divine revelation, Rose Kingdom
steeled her resolve once more.
The color in her face had completely returned.
